text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's so hot...! The glare from the 
ground is making me dizzy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, I always hear that how hard you 
train in the summer is what really 
matters...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Since we're aiming for the Kikuka Sho and 
then the Tenno Sho (Spring), we need to 
train thoroughly right here!
